pages.title: Beast Taming Potion
pages.text: Drink a $(bold)Beast Taming Potion$() and the distance at which wild animals start fleeing shortens by its tier: level I $(bold)25%$(), level II $(bold)50%$(), level III $(bold)80%$(), lasting 3 / 5 / 8 minutes respectively.$(br2)At level III you can walk right up to wild animals. Domesticated animals never flee from you anyway, so this potion only matters out in the wild.

pages.title: Brewing
pages.text: Brewed in the brewing stand from an $(bold)awkward potion$(): add $(bold)wheat$() for level I, a $(bold)cornflower$() for level II, and a $(bold)lily of the valley$() for level III. $(br2)The reduction percentages and durations of all three tiers are configurable, and the potions appear under the $(bold)food and drinks$() tab.
